system.description:
You reach out to draw another to your side. Your victim need not see you nor be seen - as long as you know them, they feel an inexorable pull toward you.

Ask a Narrator for assistance, giving the person to be summoned, your Social Traits, and whether you use the Leadership Ability. The Narrator makes a Social Challenge in your stead (Leadership retest). On a success the subject comes to you by any means possible, avoiding obstacles, until they arrive and make their presence known; you learn nothing of the outcome and may try again after five minutes. You can only Summon someone you know - at minimum someone you have spoken with for a few minutes or targeted with Presence before. Competing summons draw the victim to the caller of the most powerful generation.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: Until the subject arrives or resists
